title: Shard-aware token latency SLIs + adaptive circuit-shed dashboard for regional failover
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Token-level latency SLIs today are computed at a coarse service level and miss skew from individual GPU shards/node pools and cross-region failover patterns. This ticket implements shard-aware aggregation of token latency SLIs, surfaces adaptive circuit-breaker triggers in Grafana, and adds an operational dashboard that ties shedding decisions to observed token-level distributions and KV/cache hit patterns. The goal is to both (1) improve SLO fidelity for customers by attributing latency sources to shard/region and (2) provide runbook-friendly visuals and thresholds to drive automatic and manual load-shedding during capacity pressure or regional degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Define a canonical token-latency SLI computed per-shard and per-region with percentiles (p50,p90,p99) and tokenized-distribution histograms
Instrument and emit shard_id and region tags on token latency metrics for all inference paths (sync/streaming/batch)
Join token SLI panels with KV cache hit-rate and batch-size distributions in a single Grafana dashboard
Add an adaptive circuit-breaker panel that shows current threshold, recent triggers, and suggested backoff values; circuit becomes actionable via existing control API
Create alerts that map to runbook steps: automated soft-shed -> escalate -> full circuit (with fallbacks)
Run a canary in eu-west-1 for 48h with traffic split to validate metrics correctness and shedding behaviour
Document changes in the reliability runbook and link to the dashboard and PRs
tech_notes: Emit per-token latency as two metrics: token_process_time_ms (histogram) and token_emit_time_ms (summary) to separate compute vs downstream shipping latency
Use histogram buckets aligned with observed token latency distribution (1ms,2ms,4ms,8ms,16ms,32ms,64ms,128ms,256ms,512ms)
Attach 'shard_id', 'zone', 'region', 'model_variant', and 'cache_hit' tags to each metric to enable multi-dimensional rollups
Aggregate SLIs via Prometheus recording rules into per-shard time series, then roll up to region-level using weighted percentiles based on token count
Adaptive circuit-breaker uses a short-window rolling p99 + error-rate heuristic and a KL divergence check vs baseline distribution to detect regressions rather than transient noise
Expose a read-only Grafana dashboard and a control panel that calls the controlplane API to flip circuit states for manual experiments
Instrument low-overhead sampling (1% default) for full trace payloads to correlate traces with high-latency tokens without spamming APM
tasks: 1) Schema: add shard_id and cache_hit fields to token metric proto and update exporter
2) Instrumentation: patch runtime token path (continuous-batcher + streaming emitter) to populate tags
3) Prometheus: add recording rules for shard-level p50/p90/p99 and token counts
4) Dashboard: build Grafana panels for per-shard heatmap, regional rollup, batch-size vs latency correlation, and circuit status timeline
5) Circuit logic: implement adaptive-threshold algorithm in controlplane with safe defaults and cooldowns
6) Alerts & Runbook: author alert definitions and step-by-step playbook for manual/automatic shedding
7) Canary: deploy to eu-west-1 with 5% traffic for 48h; capture metrics and check stability
8) Docs & PR: open PRs, add Confluence design doc, and update reliability runbook
